g.text: Temperature follows a strong annual cycle (warmest month on average: July 22.7 °C, coldest: January 2.6 °C) with daily swings on top; the detail shows the wettest day (17 Aug 2024, 113.8 mm) where rain fell in
short bursts of up to 26.7 mm per 10 min.
Data: GeoSphere Austria klima-v2-10min, station Wien Hohe Warte (105), 263,088 10-min rows, CC BY 4.0.
